summary: This page covers the Stick welding setup procedure for the Vulcan OmniPro 220, including how to connect the ground clamp cable, electrode holder cable, and power cord.
text_content:
Stick Setup

Connect Cables

Ground Clamp Cable in Negative Socket
Ground Clamp
Electrode Holder Cable in Positive Socket
Electrode Holder

1. Plug Ground Clamp Cable into Negative Socket. Twist clockwise all the way to lock in place.
2. Plug Electrode Holder Cable into Positive Socket. Twist clockwise all the way to lock in place.

Connect Power Cord

Power Input

Plug either 120VAC or 240VAC Power Cord into Power Input Socket.

Note: Plug will only fit one way.

WARNING! TO PREVENT SERIOUS INJURY FROM ACCIDENTAL OPERATION: Do not plug cord into wall outlet at this time.

Item 57812     For technical questions, please call 1-800-444-3353.     Page 27

key_facts: Ground Clamp Cable plugs into the Negative Socket for Stick welding
Electrode Holder Cable plugs into the Positive Socket for Stick welding
Cables are locked in place by twisting clockwise all the way
The welder supports either 120VAC or 240VAC power input
The power cord plug will only fit one way into the Power Input Socket
Do not plug the power cord into the wall outlet during setup to prevent accidental operation
Item number for this welder is 57812
This information is on page 27 of the manual
